title: ST 2110-40: Expand dissector regression coverage and refactor 10-bit handoff to VANC
description:
Expand the ST2110-40 regression test suite to be more thorough, and refactor the ST2110-40 handoff to st291 to preserve the entire 10-bit array (this is useful for a soon-to-be-submitted patches for ST2038 support so it can leverage common code)

This MR incorporates feedback by @alagoutte to split the dissector changes from the GUI change into multiple MRs.

Assisted-by: Codex

+DECODE_AS_ARGS = (
+    # The captures contain RTP without signaling identifying it as RTP.
+    '-d', 'udp.port==5000,rtp',
+    '-d', 'udp.port==5010,rtp',
+    '-d', 'udp.port==1234,rtp',

+    # PT 100 as ST 2110-40, so explicitly decode it.
+    '-d', 'rtp.pt==100,st2110_40',
+)
+
+
+def _tshark_fields(cmd_tshark, capture, fields, env):
+    return subprocess.check_output((
+        cmd_tshark,
+        '-r', capture,
+        *DECODE_AS_ARGS,
+        '-Y', 'st2110_40',
+        '-T', 'fields',
+        '-E', 'occurrence=a',
+        '-E', 'aggregator=|',
+        *(arg for field in fields for arg in ('-e', field)),
+    ), encoding='utf-8', env=env)
+
+
+def _byte_field_signatures(cmd_tshark, capture, field, env):
+    stdout = _tshark_fields(
+        cmd_tshark, capture, ('frame.number', field), env)
+    signatures = []
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        _frame, field_value = line.split('\t')
+        values = field_value.split('|') if field_value else []
+        signatures.append([
+            (len(value_bytes), hashlib.sha256(value_bytes).hexdigest())
+            for value in values
+            for value_bytes in (bytes.fromhex(value),)
+        ])
+    return signatures

commits_data.title: ST 2110-40: Preserve all ten UDW bits for VANC subdissectors
commits_data.message:
ST 2110-40: Preserve all ten UDW bits for VANC subdissectors

Introduce a transport-independent ST 291 packet representation and normalize DID-through-checksum words in the shared layer. Contiguous transports such as ST 2110-40 and ST 2038 can provide their original packed TVB, while channel-aware transports such as raw SDI can provide logical words after handling raster interleaving and stride.

Centralize parity and checksum processing, canonical 10-bit and byte-oriented UDW construction, and DID/SDID application dispatch. Keep the public subdissector TVB byte-oriented while exposing the full-width TVB through the C context.

Assisted-by: Codex

ST 2110-40: Expand dissector regression coverage

Cover decode-as behavior, every registered header field, UDW payloads, empty and malformed packets, checksum and parity handling, and all expert diagnostics. Use a compressed pcap fixture consistent with the other dissector captures.
